analysis: This batch enables Gemma 4 tensor parallel as a generation mode. Gemma4ResidentAdapterDefinition.swift head:15 adds .tensorParallel; head:18 sets tensorParallelKeepsPromptPrefixes=true, which a load agreement binds. Gemma4PlacementFamily.swift head:42-47 builds a Gemma4TensorParallelPlan from the decoded root. The decode at head:37-38 still enforces the registered configuration and its geometry. Head:157-190 exposes the plan, tensor cuts and overlap bytes. Gemma4StageGeometry.swift head:13-14,49-50 only names existing constants (128/8), with unchanged validation. Gemma4StateBudget.swift head:29-53 adds a ranks parameter restricted to {1,2} and divisibility. The pipeline default ranks=1 leaves the pinned 719,380,600 ceiling check intact (head:80-84). Gemma4PrefillTransient head:108-123 generalises query heads and adds a decode-row sum; the original layers overload keeps its old semantics. New Gemma4TensorParallelRequestBudget.swift is a memory ledger using checked products and sums. It validates that the allocator bound is at least the logical size. Charges include a 5.5 GiB activation floor, the freed-buffer cache and collective frames. Prefix-capture memory is charged, but the prefix memory tier is explicitly not charged (head:34-37). That relies on QwenStagePrefixCache eviction, which is outside this batch. Security relevance: T-041/SEC-035 prefix-cache scope. TP prefix reuse on the resident and SSD tiers (Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix) must preserve the coordinator cacheSalt scope and the HMAC naming and KEK binding. A-001 plaintext also now crosses inter-rank collectives (QwenTensorParallelSealCodec frames, ClusterTensorParallelRequestAllowance). Sealing and authentication of those frames, and of the TP load agreement, are not in this batch. Gemma4RequestGeometry.swift appears only as metadata and a patch excerpt; its source was not supplied. No concrete regression is visible: the changes here are metadata and budget arithmetic. Integration should verify these points: TP prefix caching uses the same scoped salt and SSD crypto as the pipeline; TP collective frames are sealed between ranks; the TP runtime enforces requestBytes at admission (an availability concern).
